hook.name: V2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all graduated launchpad v2 memecoin pools. Takes a percentage fee on every swap via afterSwap using the delta return mechanism, accumulates fees per pool, and on demand converts memecoin-denominated fees to the quote currency via internal swaps, distributing proceeds among the protocol, a buyback-and-lock vault, and the pool creator according to fee terms frozen at registration.
